scope: Exact original fixtures, current installed renderer; isolated production StudioWindow; no live network/auth/native drafts; internal marks, not compositor presentation. Six opens per process, first two excluded.
limitations: OS file cache, thermal state and other applications were not controlled; no statistical-significance or online SLA claim.
Reveal is an internal Studio mark. DOM observation includes polling; neither is compositor presentation or OS input latency.
Historic 44/45 used an older renderer. Current 44/45 holds installed renderer and Desktop modules fixed.
No live API/IAM, sockets, business backend or native draft IPC in this replay.
One small top-document MutationObserver records first agent input appearance and disconnects immediately. Agent measurement is DOM/hit-test availability, not input event latency.
Long-task collection extends to the probe after initial artboards render; totals are not exclusive startup CPU. Host iframe reporting no long-task entries does not prove no work.
Independent trace is for attribution only, excluded from timing medians. Trace inclusive samples overlap and must not be added.
